pet_notes: Compact stern-cute galaxy octopus with a large rounded cobalt-indigo head, turquoise facial center, huge emerald eyes under heavy expressive brow ridges, eight thick curled blue-violet tentacles with cream-and-gold suction cups, folded front tentacles, gold scrollwork cuff, and round gold cosmic-wave medallion. Preserve the original polished storybook 3D-painterly material, galaxy speckles and swirls, compact full-body silhouette, stern observant expression, and minimal accessories. Personality is composed, vigilant, quietly protective, deliberate, and secretly affectionate. At pet size prioritize eye direction, head silhouette, eight-tentacle fan, gold suction cups, cuff, and medallion.
style_notes: Preserve the attached image as sole visual authority: polished luminous storybook 3D-painterly rendering, deep cobalt/indigo/violet skin with cyan highlights, sparse embedded pink-cyan-gold star specks, large green irises, gold accents, clean compact silhouette, transparent-ready sprite construction; simplify only tiny surface speckles when needed for 60px readability.

personality.summary: Composed, vigilant, quietly protective, deliberate, and secretly affectionate.
personality.animation_mannerisms: Physical eye globes lead the gaze; heavy brows and eyelids reinforce emotion; the planted curled tentacle fan provides restrained counterbalance; the cuff and medallion stay attached.

visual_decisions.identity: Compact stern-cute octopus with a large cobalt-indigo mantle, turquoise face center, huge emerald eyes under heavy brows, exactly eight thick curled blue-violet tentacles, cream-and-gold suction cups, folded front pair, gold cuff, and round cosmic-wave medallion.
visual_decisions.small_size_priority: Large emerald eyes, stern brow silhouette, rounded mantle, eight-tentacle fan, gold suction cups, cuff, and medallion remain readable at 60px.
visual_decisions.surface_policy: Preserve luminous blue-violet galaxy swirls and sparse embedded cyan, pink, and gold specks while simplifying only tiny speckles that would muddy the 60px silhouette.
visual_decisions.anatomy_policy: Exactly eight connected tentacles in every state; waving, waiting, and review move existing front tentacles instead of creating extra limbs.
visual_decisions.running_left: Independently generated because mirroring would invert the asymmetric cuff and medallion relationship.
visual_decisions.look_mechanics: Lower tentacle fan planted; physical whole-eye rotation, eyelid and brow reshaping, subtle mantle pitch/yaw, small continuous tip counterbalance, stable cuff limb, and attached medallion follow-through; no whole-sprite rotation.
